subject: Request: Suncrest Health — senior signoff for hosted-API concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Marissa / Steph / Mina — quick one. Suncrest (Laura Jensen in procurement) just landed the procurement deadline: they need final commercial terms by end of week to align their board. They've been piloting Hosted API for their patient intake and clinical summarization workflows. Summary: they want a 12-month committed usage agreement with the following ask: 30% off list hosted-API usage rates (tokens) starting at their committed baseline.

Why they’re asking:
- Strategic: Suncrest is running a cross-region pilot (3 hospitals) and has strong go-forward intent if price and SLOs work.
- Volume: They’re committing to ~35B tokens over 12 months (blended forecast attached).
- Competitive pressure: Main competitor offered a deeper short-term concession and procurement insists on parity.

Why we should consider it:
- ARR math: With onboarding uplift and additional product expansion (reranking + embeddings), projected ARR contribution over 12 months is ~USD 2.2M.
- Case study potential: Clinical outcomes team is open to a joint case study and co-marketing.

Ask: can we get senior signoff for a concession up to 30% (we’d accept an approved floor at 25% if needed)? Procurement timeline is tight. I’ve attached the usage forecast, draft MSA redlines, and mutual action plan.

Attachments: SC-4721_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx, Suncrest_MSA_redlines.pdf, Suncrest_mutual_action_plan.docx

—Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@suncresthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@suncresthealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 13:04:22 -04:00
Subject: Re: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Ben / Marissa — thanks for the prompt summary. Confirming Suncrest’s position: we will commit to the 12-month volume outlined in the forecast if we secure a 30% off list rate for Hosted API usage (consistent across text gen and embedding tokens). Procurement has board approval contingent on pricing.

We are happy to provide a short (non-confidential) statement for a joint case study and prioritize Redwood for multi-hospital deployment if commercials close this week. Please escalate as needed.

—Laura

Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2029 09:18:05 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Forwarding Laura's reply and the attached materials — procurement needs a yes/no on 30% by Friday COB. Mina, can you confirm the P&L impact and whether 25% is our absolute floor without additional concessions? Ben, outline non-price levers we can offer (e.g., phased ramp, commit/true-up cadence, slight SLO adjustments for peak tokens).

Key numbers (from forecast):
- Committed volume: ~35B tokens / 12 months
- Expected billed month 1: 2.4B tokens, ramp to 4.0B/mo by M4
- Expected ARR (net of 30%): ~1.9M

This is time-sensitive; procurement is asking for a countersigned MSA.

—Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2029 11:02:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Marissa / Ben — I ran the rough economics on the forecast. A few points and a suggested counter-structure:

1) Blended unit economics (current list price basis):
   - List: $0.009 per 1k tokens (example blended text/embedding rate)
   - 30% off -> effective $0.0063 per 1k tokens
   - 25% off -> effective $0.00675 per 1k tokens
2) Impact to gross margin: at 30% deep concession, incremental margin compression is substantial in early months (~6–8% absolute on the deal lifecycle), but recovers if cross-sell to higher-margin features occurs.

Recommended structure to mitigate: 
- Approve up to 25% today; escalate to 30% only with both: (a) 12-month prepayment or (b) legal-approved revenue protection (minimum monthly committed invoice + true-up plus DPA amendments).
- Require a documented business review at M3 and M6 with adoption KPIs (tokens, feature expansion, uptime metrics) to protect economics.

If you want me to model a 30% prepay scenario, I can do that by EOD.

—Mina
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2029 12:42:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Mina — appreciate the model. A few practical mitigations from the sales/ops side: 
- We can propose a staged discount: 22% for first 90 days, step to 30% once committed baseline is met for two consecutive months.
- Prepay is on the table; Suncrest prefers spread payments over quarterly invoicing. If prepay is required we may lose some of the procurement urgency.
- Offer a controlled capacity carve (dedicated pool + throttles) with a minor premium to protect tail-costs.

If finance signs off on 25% with the M3/M6 review and a monthly minimum invoice, I think we close this week. Laura is willing to give us the case study and prioritize roll-out.

—Ben

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Suncrest urgent: pricing ask and exec signoff request

Thanks everyone for the quick analysis. Given the strategic upside (multi-hospital footprint + public case study) and the financial mitigations Mina outlined, I approve a 25% hosted-API usage concession for Suncrest with the following binding conditions: 

1) Commercial conditions (required):
   - 12-month committed term (no opt-out within term)
   - Minimum monthly invoice equal to 60% of the pro-rated committed monthly baseline (true-up at month close)
   - Prepayment of first two quarters (or equivalent letter of credit) to mitigate cash flow risk
2) Operational conditions:
   - M3 and M6 business reviews with Sales, Finance and CS; adoption KPIs to be documented in the mutual action plan
   - Onboarding to Dedicated capacity optional add-on; if Suncrest requests dedicated GPU pools we will bill the capacity premium (outside token discount)
3) Legal / contractual:
   - Legal to include revenue protection clause and carve-out for exceptional overages; DPA changes must be agreed before countersign.

If Suncrest accepts those conditions we will finalize at 25% and notify Procurement to proceed with countersignature. I will not approve 30% without prepay+revenue protection in place. Marissa/Ben: please get me the counterparty confirmation and DocuSign link once procurement agrees.

—Stephanie
SVP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
